eg: According to a recent survey, most adults read fewer books than they did ten years ago.
egCn: 根据最近的一项调查，大多数成年人读的书比十年前少了。

eg: Even supporters of the policy admit that it will be expensive to introduce.
egCn: 就连这项政策的支持者也承认，推行起来会花费不菲。

eg: Some experts argue that homework does little to improve learning in primary schools.
egCn: 一些专家认为，家庭作业对提高小学生的学习效果作用不大。

eg: Clear rules help companies avoid misunderstandings with their customers.
egCn: 明确的规则有助于公司避免与顾客产生误解。

eg: Every citizen should have access to basic healthcare, whatever their income.
egCn: 无论收入多少，每个公民都应享有基本医疗服务。

eg: Advertising can have a strong influence on children's eating behaviour.
egCn: 广告会对儿童的饮食行为产生很大影响。

eg: Video calls allow families to communicate easily even when they live far apart.
egCn: 视频通话让家人即使相隔很远也能方便地交流。

eg: Local libraries play an important role in bringing the community together.
egCn: 地方图书馆在凝聚社区方面发挥着重要作用。

eg: Small shops find it increasingly difficult to compete with large online retailers.
egCn: 小商店越来越难与大型网络零售商竞争。

eg: Air pollution can cause serious damage to the lungs, especially in young children.
egCn: 空气污染会对肺部造成严重损害，尤其是对幼儿。

eg: Team sports help children develop social skills such as cooperation and patience.
egCn: 团队运动有助于孩子培养合作与耐心等社交技能。

eg: Health experts recommend at least thirty minutes of physical activity every day.
egCn: 健康专家建议每天至少进行三十分钟的身体活动。

eg: Official figures show that unemployment fell slightly in the second half of the year.
egCn: 官方数据显示，下半年失业率略有下降。

eg: Setting realistic goals helps learners stay motivated over a long period.
egCn: 设定切实可行的目标能帮助学习者长期保持学习动力。

eg: Governments cannot afford to ignore the needs of an ageing population.
egCn: 政府不能忽视老龄化人口的需求。

cn: 独立的；自主的；不受影响的
eg: Living away from home helps students become more independent and confident.
egCn: 离家生活有助于学生变得更加独立和自信。

eg: Cycling is cheap and healthy. In addition, it produces no harmful emissions.
egCn: 骑自行车既便宜又健康。此外，它不会产生有害排放。

eg: There should be a strict limit on the number of cars allowed in the city centre.
egCn: 应严格限制允许进入市中心的汽车数量。

eg: Accurate data is essential if governments want to plan public services effectively.
egCn: 政府要想有效规划公共服务，准确的数据必不可少。

eg: Schools in poorer areas should receive additional funding to support struggling pupils.
egCn: 贫困地区的学校应获得额外资金，用于帮助学习吃力的学生。

eg: More companies are adopting a four-day working week to attract talented staff.
egCn: 越来越多的公司开始采用四天工作制，以吸引人才。

eg: The city's annual budget for public parks has been cut by ten per cent.
egCn: 该市公园的年度预算被削减了百分之十。

eg: Television campaigns have raised public awareness of the dangers of smoking.
egCn: 电视宣传活动提高了公众对吸烟危害的认识。

eg: Learning a musical instrument can be highly beneficial for children's memory.
egCn: 学习一门乐器对孩子的记忆力大有裨益。

eg: Many people associate success with wealth, but happiness depends on much more.
egCn: 许多人把成功和财富联系在一起，但幸福取决于更多因素。

eg: Many hospitals are already working at full capacity during the winter months.
egCn: 在冬季的几个月里，许多医院已经在满负荷运转。

eg: Some advertisers claim that their products can improve your memory within weeks.
egCn: 一些广告商声称，他们的产品能在几周内提高你的记忆力。

eg: Researchers conducted a survey of two thousand teenagers about their sleeping habits.
egCn: 研究人员就睡眠习惯对两千名青少年进行了调查。

cn: 相当大的；可观的；相当多的
eg: Building a new airport would require a considerable amount of public money.
egCn: 修建一座新机场需要大量公共资金。

eg: The housing crisis has forced many young adults to live with their parents.
egCn: 住房危机迫使许多年轻人与父母同住。

eg: Governments must find better ways to deal with rising levels of traffic.
egCn: 政府必须找到更好的办法来应对日益增长的交通流量。

eg: The number of people working from home has risen sharply over the past decade.
egCn: 过去十年里，居家办公的人数急剧上升。

eg: Wealth should be distributed more fairly so that everyone can live with dignity.
egCn: 财富应当分配得更公平，让每个人都能有尊严地生活。

eg: The main drawback of online learning is the lack of face-to-face contact.
egCn: 在线学习的主要缺点是缺少面对面的交流。

cn: 高效的；效率高的；有能力的
eg: Modern washing machines are far more efficient and use less water and electricity.
egCn: 现代洗衣机效率高得多，用水用电都更少。

eg: Strict inspections are needed to ensure that food sold in shops is safe to eat.
egCn: 需要严格检查，以确保商店出售的食品可以安全食用。

eg: This essay will examine the main causes of obesity among children.
egCn: 本文将探讨儿童肥胖的主要原因。

eg: Many students face financial difficulties because of high rents and tuition fees.
egCn: 由于房租和学费高昂，许多学生面临经济困难。

eg: The gap between rich and poor has widened in many developed countries.
egCn: 在许多发达国家，贫富差距已经扩大。

eg: A university degree no longer guarantees a well-paid job.
egCn: 大学学位已不再能保证找到高薪工作。

eg: Scientists are investigating whether screen time affects children's ability to concentrate.
egCn: 科学家正在研究屏幕使用时间是否会影响儿童的专注力。

eg: A lack of affordable housing is pushing young families out of big cities.
egCn: 平价住房的短缺正把年轻家庭挤出大城市。

eg: The success of a small business depends largely on the quality of its staff.
egCn: 小企业的成功在很大程度上取决于员工的素质。

eg: A poor diet in childhood can lead to serious health problems later in life.
egCn: 童年时期饮食不良可能导致日后出现严重的健康问题。

eg: Scientists have found a clear link between air pollution and asthma in children.
egCn: 科学家发现空气污染与儿童哮喘之间存在明显关联。

eg: A growing number of people are choosing to work from home at least twice a week.
egCn: 越来越多的人选择每周至少在家办公两天。

eg: Investing in public transport will save the government money in the long run.
egCn: 从长远来看，投资公共交通能为政府节省开支。
collocations: pay off in the long run

eg: It is worth bearing in mind that not every family can afford a computer.
egCn: 值得注意的是，并非每个家庭都买得起电脑。
collocations: it is worth bearing in mind

eg: Many flights were cancelled due to heavy snow across northern Europe.
egCn: 由于北欧普降大雪，许多航班被取消。

eg: Hosting the Olympic Games can boost tourism, but the costs are often enormous.
egCn: 举办奥运会能促进旅游业，但成本往往非常高昂。

eg: Online banking enables customers to manage their money at any time of day.
egCn: 网上银行使客户能够在一天中的任何时间管理自己的资金。

eg: The study was carried out over five years with more than ten thousand participants.
egCn: 这项研究历时五年，有一万多名参与者。

eg: Schools place too much emphasis on exam results and not enough on creativity.
egCn: 学校过分强调考试成绩，而对创造力重视不够。

eg: In comparison with cities, rural areas have cleaner air but fewer job opportunities.
egCn: 与城市相比，农村地区空气更清新，但就业机会更少。

eg: There is growing concern about the effect of social media on young people's mental health.
egCn: 人们越来越担心社交媒体对年轻人心理健康的影响。

eg: Governments should invest more in early childhood education and childcare.
egCn: 政府应加大对幼儿教育和托育的投入。

eg: Approximately one third of the city's residents use public transport every day.
egCn: 该市约三分之一的居民每天乘坐公共交通。

eg: Learning a language to an advanced level requires years of hard work and commitment.
egCn: 要把一门语言学到高级水平，需要多年的刻苦努力和全心投入。

eg: Recent studies confirm that regular exercise reduces the risk of heart disease.
egCn: 最近的研究证实，经常锻炼能降低患心脏病的风险。

eg: Governments must address the root causes of crime, not just its symptoms.
egCn: 政府必须解决犯罪的根源，而不仅仅是其表面现象。

eg: Young people account for nearly half of all online shoppers in the country.
egCn: 年轻人占该国所有网购者的近一半。

eg: Building more affordable homes would help alleviate the pressure on city rents.
egCn: 建造更多平价住房有助于缓解城市房租的压力。

eg: Problems often arise when new technology is introduced without proper training.
egCn: 在没有适当培训的情况下引进新技术，往往会出现问题。

cn: 以……为代价；在损害……的情况下
eg: Economic growth should not come at the expense of the natural environment.
egCn: 经济增长不应以牺牲自然环境为代价。

eg: Researchers must take care to avoid bias when choosing participants for a study.
egCn: 研究人员在挑选研究参与者时必须注意避免偏差。

cn: 令人信服的；引人入胜的；强烈的
eg: There is compelling evidence that early education improves children's later life chances.
egCn: 有令人信服的证据表明，早期教育能改善儿童日后的人生机遇。

eg: Contrary to popular belief, many older people are confident users of technology.
egCn: 与普遍看法相反，许多老年人能熟练自信地使用科技产品。

eg: Spending too long on screens can be detrimental to children's eyesight.
egCn: 长时间看屏幕可能有损儿童的视力。

eg: Air quality in the city has deteriorated as the number of cars has increased.
egCn: 随着汽车数量增加，这座城市的空气质量已经恶化。

eg: Drastic measures are needed to reduce the amount of plastic waste in the oceans.
egCn: 需要采取严厉措施来减少海洋中的塑料垃圾。

eg: It may be impossible to eliminate poverty completely, but it can be greatly reduced.
egCn: 完全消除贫困也许不可能，但可以大大减少贫困。

eg: International students may encounter difficulties with housing and language in their first year.
egCn: 留学生在第一年可能会遇到住房和语言方面的困难。

eg: Teachers should evaluate students on their progress as well as their final grades.
egCn: 教师评价学生时，既要看期末成绩，也要看进步情况。

eg: It is evident from the chart that car ownership rose steadily over the period.
egCn: 从图表中可以明显看出，汽车拥有量在此期间稳步上升。

eg: Excessive use of antibiotics has made some infections much harder to treat.
egCn: 过度使用抗生素已使某些感染变得更难治疗。

eg: Children who are exposed to several languages early tend to learn them more easily.
egCn: 从小接触多种语言的孩子往往学起来更容易。

eg: The decision to raise university fees has had far-reaching consequences for students.
egCn: 提高大学学费的决定给学生带来了深远影响。

eg: It is not feasible for every family in rural areas to live without a car.
egCn: 要让农村地区的每个家庭都不用汽车生活，是不可行的。

eg: House prices fluctuated throughout the decade before rising sharply in the final year.
egCn: 房价在这十年间起伏不定，最后一年急剧上涨。

eg: Group projects foster cooperation and communication skills among students.
egCn: 小组项目能培养学生的合作与沟通能力。

eg: Rapid urban growth has given rise to serious traffic and housing problems.
egCn: 城市的快速扩张引发了严重的交通和住房问题。

eg: A lack of reliable internet access can hinder students' progress in rural areas.
egCn: 缺乏稳定的网络接入可能会阻碍农村地区学生的学业进步。

cn: 极其重要的；必要的；迫切的
eg: It is imperative that governments act quickly to reduce carbon emissions.
egCn: 各国政府必须迅速采取行动减少碳排放。

cn: 强制实行；征（税）；把……强加于
eg: Some cities impose heavy taxes on sugary drinks to protect public health.
egCn: 一些城市对含糖饮料征收重税，以保护公众健康。

eg: Tax breaks give companies an incentive to invest in clean energy.
egCn: 税收减免能激励企业投资清洁能源。

eg: Part-time jobs give teenagers valuable insight into how the world of work operates.
egCn: 兼职工作能让青少年深入了解职场是如何运作的。

eg: A quiet, well-lit room is far more conducive to effective studying.
egCn: 安静、光线充足的房间更有利于高效学习。

eg: The new law could curtail the freedom of journalists to criticise the government.
egCn: 这项新法律可能会限制记者批评政府的自由。

eg: There is often a discrepancy between what people say about recycling and what they actually do.
egCn: 人们对回收利用的说法和实际做法之间往往存在差异。

cn: 密不可分地；无法分开地
eg: In many developing countries, economic growth and environmental protection are inextricably linked.
egCn: 在许多发展中国家，经济增长和环境保护密不可分。
